notice: Controlled copies must be the current revision at the point of use. Printed copies are uncontrolled unless stamped.
numbering_tip: Use a clear scheme such as HSE-SOP-001. Change the revision letter or number on every approved change and record what changed.

certificate_types.title: Crane / lifting appliance thorough examination

legal.india: Factories Act 1948 s.29 and state rules: periodic examination by a competent person, commonly every 12 months (verify)
legal.gulf: Client and local authority rules: annual third-party thorough examination is commonly required (verify)
legal.canada: Provincial regulations and CSA Z150: annual inspection by a qualified person (verify)
legal.usa: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.179(j) for overhead cranes and 29 CFR 1926 Subpart CC for mobile cranes (verify)

certificate_types.note: Use the shortest of the law, the manufacturer and the client.

certificate_types.title: Lifting gear: slings, shackles, hooks, chains

legal.india: Factories Act 1948 s.29: chains, ropes and lifting tackle examined periodically, commonly every 6 months (verify)
legal.gulf: Client standards: six-monthly examination is common (verify)
legal.canada: Provincial regulations and the manufacturer (verify)
legal.usa: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.184 (slings): periodic inspection at intervals not exceeding 12 months (verify)

evidence: Item ID and safe working load
